title: Tool Manifest
description: Manifest satu tool pihak ketiga terkurasi (ROADMAP v3.0 §36). Sumber kebenaran: tools/registry.yaml (entry per tool, key = name). Loader internal/toolregistry menerapkan constraint yang sama secara fail-closed; schema ini mendokumentasikan kontrak untuk CI (signed release §40) dan review supply chain (§37).

name.description: Nama tool (key entry di tools/registry.yaml), mis. nuclei.

category.description: Kategori fungsi tool, mis. vulnerability-detection, port-scanning.

image.description: Nama image terkurasi satu tool (ROADMAP §38), mis. hermes-tool-nuclei.

version.description: Versi tool ter-pin (mis. 3.3.9). Tidak pernah auto-update saat runtime (§41).

digest.description: Digest image ter-pin (sha256:...). Diisi ulang CI saat signed release (§40).

signature_required.description: Wajib verifikasi signature image sebelum eksekusi (§40).

risk.description: Klasifikasi risk per tool (§15). Menentukan approval expectation bersama approval_requirement.

provider.description: Provider eksekusi tool — selalu docker (image terkurasi, baseline §31).

capability.description: Capability yang dilayani tool ini — harus terdaftar di capabilities/registry.yaml (§12).

network_requirement.description: Kebutuhan egress tool, mis. third-party-passive-sources (subfinder), target-http (httpx/ffuf/nuclei), target-connect-scan (nmap).

approval_requirement.description: Approval requirement per tool (§12): automatic = tanpa approval; conditional = scoped approval wajib; always = TIDAK PERNAH jalan tanpa approval aktif (mis. nmap).

evidence_parser.description: Parser output tool menjadi evidence terstruktur — kontrak wrapper: validation-result-json (§33/§39).

templates_version.description: Opsional: versi template ter-bake ter-pin (mis. nuclei templates v10.4.8, §41).

wordlists_version.description: Opsional: versi wordlist ter-bake ter-pin (mis. SecLists 2026.1).
